Saved payment methods
Drafted by Dodger · Reviewer M. Chen · Target Q3 · v3 · Updated just now
Problem
23% of checkout sessions abandon at the payment step. In Run 6, two of three personas would not save a card without knowing where it is stored, and called it the reason they leave.
Finding F-12Growth sync · Jul 14Checkout funnel
"I'm not saving a card unless I can see where it's stored." Two of three personas said a version of this at the payment step.
Run 6 · Interview 7 · Rajesh, returning buyer
Success metrics
Checkout completion 71% to 78% within 30 days of launch.
Repeat purchase rate up 10%.15%.
Scope
In scope: one-tap card storage at checkout, stored-card management in settings, and plain copy on where card data lives. Out of scope: Apple Pay and Google Pay, deferred to Q4.
Requirements
R1P0Save a card in one tap at checkout; card data never touches our servers.
R2P0Show where the card is stored, and by whom, at the moment of save.
R3P1Stored-card management in settings: set default, remove, expiry alerts.
R4P1Link the refund policy from the save sheet; guests treat it as a trust check.
